title: Money
description: Name the words for money, and talk about paying.
grammar: gender and articles, and the words for paying
grammarNote: Paying is a set of nouns, and they follow the usual article rules.

explanation.summary: Money has its own vocabulary, and it is the vocabulary a learner needs at the till and on the phone with a bank.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El efectivo, el cambio, el presupuesto, el descuento, el saldo y el cajero are masculine. La tarjeta, la moneda, la compra y la venta are feminine. El efectivo is cash, la tarjeta is the card you pay with, and el cajero is the cashier or the cash machine.

sections.heading: Paying
sections.body: Pagar takes a thing: pago con tarjeta, pago con efectivo. El precio is what it costs, and el descuento takes money off it. El saldo is what is left on an account, and el presupuesto is what you decided to spend.

examples.es: el saldo de mi cuenta es bajo
examples.en: the balance in my account is low

items.note: Masculine: el efectivo. You pay en efectivo, in cash.
Masculine: el cambio. It is also the exchange rate.
Masculine: el cajero. It is also the cash machine, el cajero automático.
